propositions: rebar-janitor's Discovery phase must consult rebar metrics --since/--until --output json to cite code-health trends (module-size distribution, oversized-module count, churn, refactor-to-addition ratio, cap-change events) as historical evidence during code-health assessment

rebar metrics and its four lenses (agent_process, code_health, delivery, gate_economics), source/confidence labels, and unavailable state must be documented in docs/user-guide.md so agents and contributors can discover and understand the surface
the rebar.metrics registry subsystem (MetricSpec, REGISTRY, is_authoritative helper) must be referenced in docs/reuse-surface.md so library consumers can reuse the metric declaration framework
AGENTS.md's Where to read pointer list must include a metrics navigation entry pointing to docs/user-guide.md and docs/reuse-surface.md for discoverability
discovery.md must clarify that unavailable metrics indicate signal-not-yet-accrued, not zero, and cite metrics as the historical/trend complement to one-shot snapshot tools
